name: Arjun Mehta
text: PrismTutor Studio completely transformed my approach to mathematics. Dr. Kavitha's visual methods made calculus intuitive and even fun. I scored 98% in my CBSE board exams!

name: Sunita Sharma
text: As a parent, I was amazed by the weekly progress reports and personalized attention my daughter received. Her confidence in science has skyrocketed since joining, and she cleared NEET in her first attempt.

name: Rohit Krishnan
text: Prof. Rajesh Iyer's physics classes are next-level. The virtual lab experiments make everything click. I went from struggling with mechanics to scoring AIR 342 in JEE Advanced.

name: Sneha Gupta
text: The coding course with Mr. Vikram is fantastic. I built my first Python project within a month and even qualified for ZIO! The step-by-step approach really works for beginners like me.

name: Ramesh Verma
text: The flexible scheduling and hybrid mode options made it possible for my son to attend despite his busy schedule. He improved from 72% to 96% in his CBSE boards. Excellent value for money.

name: Ananya Reddy
text: Anjali ma'am's creative writing workshops unlocked something in me. I've gone from hating essays to winning the CBSE national-level creative writing competition. Truly life-changing!
